narrative.overview: White institutional masthead, one full-width blue research entrance, authentic wing watermark and immediate working public finder. Upright source imagery and quiet white reading rows lead to scholarly directories; private workspaces remain task-focused. Persian RTL and blue/cyan/white identity remain binding. Vazirmatn is temporary.
keyCharacteristics: Immediate public search and direct destinations.
Upright authentic imagery and thin dividers.
Persian RTL and isolated mixed-direction content.
Historical archives remain separate from academic operations.

rules.name: The Source Color Rule
rules.body: Preserve original poster and cover colors; use the institutional palette for surrounding controls and layout.

rules.name: The Academic Boundary Rule
rules.body: Historical editorial records are readable archives, never live attendance, registration, summary-submission or credit opportunities. Current events and private academic operations remain separate.

dos: Do retain the authentic emblem and wing artwork and preserve the blue/cyan/white identity.
Do show source posters and journal covers completely with their real colors and provenance.
Do preserve keyboard focus, named controls, explicit status text and reduced-motion access.
Do verify long Persian text, mixed-direction content and layouts at 390, 768 and 1440 pixels.
Do distinguish historical editorial content from current academic records and keep empty states honest.
donts: Don't claim the temporary Vazirmatn font matches the reference.
Don't use decorative cyan for primary text or action labels.
Don't invent activity counts, endorsements, achievements or testimonials.
Don't infer permissions from visual role switching or historical archive membership.
Don't treat screenshot checks or this document as production-readiness approval.
Do not restore the rejected split hero or tilted poster collage.
